text: FIX `RxDatabase.exportJSON()` contained the internal `rx-state-*` collection of an RxState, so that `importJSON()` of the dump into a database without that state threw `JD1`. The collection of an RxState is no longer part of the database dump and `importJSON()` skips the `rx-state-*` entry of older dumps when the state was not added to the database.
